name: Surge
description: When you strike, the blow lands harder (+amount damage).

name: Clarity
description: When you strike, the blow cannot miss.

name: Echo
description: When you strike, a second blow follows at once (once an exchange).

name: Aegis
description: When you are struck, the blow is turned aside by amount.

name: Veil
description: When you are struck, the blow misses outright.

name: Mending
description: When you land a blow, you recover amount HP.

name: Stumble
description: When you strike, the blow goes wide.

name: Recoil
description: When you strike, you take amount damage yourself.

name: Faltering
description: When you strike, the blow lands softer (-amount damage).

name: Exposed
description: When you are struck, the blow lands harder (+amount damage).

name: Bleeding
description: When you are hurt, you lose amount more HP.

name: Marked
description: When you are struck, the blow cannot miss.
